sources.entry: django-grappelli - A jazzy skin for the Django Admin-Interface.

summary.one_liner: Django Grappelli is a grid-based skin and extension for the Django admin interface, giving it a restyled, jazzy look.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Grappelli as a grid-based alternative or extension to the Django administration interface. It is presented as a skin for the Django admin, so it changes how the existing admin looks rather than adding a separate admin site. The README's compatibility table lists Django 6.1, 6.0 and 5.2 LTS with Python 3.12 to 3.14, tested on CI. It also has a releases table showing version branches for Django 6.x and 5.x. The README gives no feature list, installation steps, or configuration details beyond these sections.
notable: Grid-based layout for the Django admin interface
Skin/extension of the existing Django admin rather than a separate admin
CI-tested against Django 6.1, 6.0 and 5.2 LTS on Python 3.12 to 3.14
Maintained release branches for Django 6.x and 5.x
caveats: Developed against the latest stable Django only; not tested against Django's master branch
Older versions are no longer supported
